title: Share of changes titled fix that repaired no bug, by which model judged them and when they merged
reading: Each bar is the percentage of sampled fixes that the model said repaired no bug. The first two bars are the same fixes read by two different models: their gap is the model. The last two bars are one model reading two periods: their gap is the period.

title: Share of traced bugs that were new code that never worked, by which model judged them and when
reading: Take only bugs that were new code that never worked, or a working thing broken later. Each bar is the percentage that were the first kind. Past the dashed line means the first kind is the more common.
